Class ScenarioSnapshotInspector

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioSnapshotInspector
public class ScenarioSnapshotInspector extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller for simulation snapshot inspection, browsing, and checkpoint resumption.

Extracted from ScenarioSetupPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Discovers existing physical saves and rolling checkpoints in saves/, visualizes their temporal metadata (epoch, moment, population, byte footprint), and coordinates warm restoration.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
